findings.summary: Dark background with small grey text is hard to read even with glasses, including the column headings and the labels.
Every row repeats the same labels, so the reader has to reread them all to find what differs. This is not the repeated company name.
The ring colours in the exposure column look alike, so the reader cannot match each percentage to its ring.
Too many numbers on each screen made the reader anxious.
English letters on the first screen made the page feel not meant for them.
Nothing explains which tracks are safe, so the reader guessed from the 0% share figure.
Many returns are missing because the tracks are younger than 3 years.
Rows are very long, with the name at the far right and the money column at the far left, so the reader loses their place.
